---
title: "04 — Viable transition identification"
---

Commit the set of **viable** transitions to model: `trans_meta_t` with `is_viable`
set by a minimum observed-transition count (`min_cardinality_abs`). Static classes are
excluded as anterior states. The threshold below is chosen from the observed-transition
diagnostic in `04d-viable-transition-identification.qmd` — see that report to justify
the value.

```{r}
#| label: viable-trans-identification
library(evoland)
db <- evoland_db$new(path = "ssp-ch.evolanddb")

lulc_meta <- db$lulc_meta_t

# commit with is_viable flag set according to criterion derived from the 04d graph
db$trans_meta_t <-
  create_trans_meta_t(
    db$trans_v,
    # min_frequency_rel = 0.005, # this is what ben used: the change rate relative
    # to the other change rates
    min_cardinality_abs = 1000, # chosen per the 04d observed-transitions diagnostic
    exclude_anterior = lulc_meta[name == "static", id_lulc]
  )
```
